{\n    loadProjects();\n  }, [activeTab, sortBy]);\n\n  const loadProjects = async (forceLoadAll = false) =&gt; {\n    setIsLoading(true);\n    try {\n      // 加载精选项目\n      const featuredResponse = await projectService.getFeaturedProjects(4);\n      if (featuredResponse.success &amp;&amp; featuredResponse.data) {\n        setFeaturedProjects(featuredResponse.data);\n      }\n\n      // 加载最近项目\n      const recentResponse = await projectService.getRecentProjects(20);\n      if (recentResponse.success &amp;&amp; recentResponse.data) {\n        setRecentProjects(recentResponse.data);\n      }\n\n      // 加载所有项目（用于\"全部\"和\"我的项目\"标签，或强制加载时）\n      if (forceLoadAll || activeTab === 'all' || activeTab === 'my') {\n        const allResponse = await projectService.getProjects({\n          page: 1,\n          pageSize: 100,\n          orderBy: sortBy === 'recent' ? 'last_opened_at' : sortBy === 'name' ? 'name' : 'created_at',\n          orderDirection: sortBy === 'recent' ? 'DESC' : 'ASC'\n        });\n        if (allResponse.success &amp;&amp; allResponse.data) {\n          setAllProjects(allResponse.data.data);\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('加载项目失败:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleCreateProject = async (data: ProjectFormData) =&gt; {\n    const response = await projectService.createProject(data);\n    if (response.success) {\n      // 创建成功后，切换到\"我的项目\"标签页以显示新创建的项目\n      setActiveTab('my');\n      // 强制重新加载所有数据（包括所有项目列表）\n      await loadProjects(true);\n    } else {\n      alert(response.error || '创建项目失败');\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleProjectClick = async (project: Project) =&gt; {\n    // 更新最后打开时间\n    await projectService.updateLastOpenedAt(project.id);\n    // 导航到项目详情页（暂时导航到AI问答页，后续可以创建项目详情页）\n    navigate(&#96;/ai-qa?projectId=${project.id}&#96;);\n  };\n\n  const handleProjectMenuClick = (e: React.MouseEvent, project: Project) =&gt; {\n    e.stopPropagation();\n    // TODO: 实现项目菜单（编辑、删除等）\n    console.log('Project menu clicked:', project);\n  };\n\n  const getDisplayProjects = () =&gt; {\n    switch (activeTab) {\n      case 'featured':\n        return featuredProjects;\n      case 'my':\n        return allProjects;\n      case 'all':\n        return allProjects;\n      default:\n        return [];\n    }\n  };\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"min-h-screen bg-gray-50\"&gt;\n      {/* 顶部导航栏 */}\n      &lt;div className=\"bg-white border-b border-gray-200 sticky top-0 z-40\"&gt;\n        &lt;div className=\"max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8\"&gt;\n          &lt;div className=\"flex items-center justify-between h-16\"&gt;\n            {/* 左侧标签页 */}\n            &lt;div className=\"flex items-center space-x-1\"&gt;\n              &lt;button\n                onClick={() =&gt; setActiveTab('all')}\n                className={&#96;px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium rounded-md transition-colors ${\n                  activeTab === 'all'\n                    ? 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700'\n                    : 'text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-100'\n                }&#96;}\n              &gt;\n                全部\n              &lt;/button&gt;\n              &lt;button\n                onClick={() =&gt; setActiveTab('my')}\n                className={&#96;px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium rounded-md transition-colors ${\n                  activeTab === 'my'\n                    ? 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700'\n                    : 'text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-100'\n                }&#96;}\n              &gt;\n                我的项目\n              &lt;/button&gt;\n              &lt;button\n                onClick={() =&gt; setActiveTab('featured')}\n                className={&#96;px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium rounded-md transition-colors ${\n                  activeTab === 'featured'\n                    ? 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700'\n                    : 'text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-100'\n                }&#96;}\n              &gt;\n                精选项目\n              &lt;/button&gt;\n            &lt;/div&gt;\n\n            {/* 右侧操作栏 */}\n            &lt;div className=\"flex items-center space-x-4\"&gt;\n              {/* 视图切换 */}\n              &lt;div className=\"flex items-center border border-gray-300 rounded-md\"&gt;\n                &lt;button className=\"p-2 hover:bg-gray-100\"&gt;\n                  &lt;List className=\"w-4 h-4 text-gray-600\" /&gt;\n                &lt;/button&gt;\n                &lt;button className=\"p-2 hover:bg-gray-100 border-l border-gray-300\"&gt;\n                  &lt;Grid className=\"w-4 h-4 text-gray-600\" /&gt;\n                &lt;/button&gt;\n              &lt;/div&gt;\n\n              {/* 排序 */}\n              &lt;div className=\"relative\"&gt;\n                &lt;button className=\"flex items-center space-x-1 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-gray-700 border border-gray-300 rounded-md hover:bg-gray-50\"&gt;\n                  &lt;span&gt;最近&lt;/span&gt;\n                  &lt;ChevronDown className=\"w-4 h-4\" /&gt;\n                &lt;/button&gt;\n              &lt;/div&gt;\n\n              {/* 新建按钮 */}\n              &lt;button\n                onClick={() =&gt; setIsNewProjectModalOpen(true)}\n                className=\"flex items-center space-x-2 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-white bg-blue-600 rounded-md hover:bg-blue-700 transition-colors\"\n              &gt;\n                &lt;Plus className=\"w-4 h-4\" /&gt;\n                &lt;span&gt;新建&lt;/span&gt;\n              &lt;/button&gt;\n            &lt;/div&gt;\n          &lt;/div&gt;\n        &lt;/div&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n\n      {/* 内容区域 */}\n      &lt;div className=\"max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8\"&gt;\n        {isLoading ? (\n          &lt;div className=\"flex items-center justify-center py-12\"&gt;\n            &lt;div className=\"animate-spin rounded-full h-8 w-8 border-b-2 border-blue-600\"&gt;&lt;/div&gt;\n          &lt;/div&gt;\n        ) : (\n          &lt;&gt;\n            {activeTab === 'featured' ? (\n              &lt;&gt;\n                &lt;FeaturedProjectList\n                  projects={featuredProjects}\n                  onProjectClick={handleProjectClick}\n                /&gt;\n                &lt;RecentProjectList\n                  projects={recentProjects}\n                  onProjectClick={handleProjectClick}\n                  onNewProjectClick={() =&gt; setIsNewProjectModalOpen(true)}\n                  onProjectMenuClick={handleProjectMenuClick}\n                /&gt;\n              &lt;/&gt;\n            ) : (\n              &lt;div&gt;\n                &lt;h2 className=\"text-xl font-semibold text-gray-900 mb-4\"&gt;\n                  {activeTab === 'all' ? '全部项目' : '我的项目'}\n                &lt;/h2&gt;\n                &lt;div className=\"grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4\"&gt;\n                  &lt;NewProjectCard onClick={() =&gt; setIsNewProjectModalOpen(true)} /&gt;\n                  {getDisplayProjects().map((project) =&gt; (\n                    &lt;ProjectCard\n                      key={project.id}\n                      project={project}\n                      onClick={() =&gt; handleProjectClick(project)}\n                      onMenuClick={(e) =&gt; handleProjectMenuClick(e, project)}\n                    /&gt;\n                  ))}\n                &lt;/div&gt;\n              &lt;/div&gt;\n            )}\n          &lt;/&gt;\n        )}\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n\n      {/* 新建项目对话框 */}\n      &lt;NewProjectModal\n        isOpen={isNewProjectModalOpen}\n        onClose={() =&gt; setIsNewProjectModalOpen(false)}\n        onSubmit={handleCreateProject}\n      /&gt;\n    &lt;/div&gt;\n  );\n};\n\nexport default HomePage;\n",
  "totalLinesInFile": 229
}

{
  "contents": "import { DatabaseManager } from '../config/database';\nimport { \n  Project, \n  CreateProjectDTO, \n  UpdateProjectDTO, \n  QueryOptions, \n  PaginatedResult,\n  ProjectStatus,\n  ProjectType\n} from '../types/database';\n\nexport class ProjectModel {\n  private db: DatabaseManager;\n\n  constructor(db: DatabaseManager) {\n    this.db = db;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 创建项目\n   */\n  async create(data: CreateProjectDTO): Promise&lt;Project&gt; {\n    const sql = &#96;\n      INSERT INTO projects (\n        name, description, cover_image, icon, type, status, created_by, last_opened_at\n      )\n      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\n    &#96;;\n    \n    const values = [\n      data.name,\n      data.description || null,\n      data.cover_image || null,\n      data.icon || null,\n      data.type || ProjectType.NORMAL,\n      data.status || ProjectStatus.ACTIVE,\n      data.created_by || null,\n      data.last_opened_at || null\n    ];\n\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\n    const lastId = (result as any).lastID || (result as any).id;\n    \n    // 获取创建的项目\n    return this.findById(lastId) as Promise&lt;Project&gt;;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 根据ID获取项目\n   */\n  async findById(id: number): Promise&lt;Project | null&gt; {\n    const sql = 'SELECT * FROM projects WHERE id = ?';\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, [id]);\n    return result.length &gt; 0 ? this.parseRow(result[0]) as Project : null;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 获取所有项目\n   */\n  async findAll(options: QueryOptions = {}): Promise&lt;PaginatedResult&lt;Project&gt;&gt; {\n    let sql = 'SELECT * FROM projects';\n    const values: any[] = [];\n    const conditions: string[] = [];\n\n    // 添加WHERE条件\n    if (options.where) {\n      Object.entries(options.where).forEach(([key, value]) =&gt; {\n        if (value === null) {\n          conditions.push(&#96;${key} IS NULL&#96;);\n        } else {\n          conditions.push(&#96;${key} = ?&#96;);\n          values.push(value);\n        }\n      });\n    }\n\n    if (conditions.length &gt; 0) {\n      sql += ' WHERE ' + conditions.join(' AND ');\n    }\n\n    // 添加排序\n    if (options.orderBy) {\n      sql += &#96; ORDER BY ${options.orderBy} ${options.orderDirection || 'ASC'}&#96;;\n    } else {\n      sql += ' ORDER BY created_at DESC';\n    }\n\n    // 获取总数\n    const countSql = sql.replace('SELECT *', 'SELECT COUNT(*) as count');\n    const countResult = await this.db.query(countSql, values);\n    const total = countResult[0].count;\n\n    // 添加分页\n    if (options.limit) {\n      sql += &#96; LIMIT ${options.limit}&#96;;\n      if (options.offset) {\n        sql += &#96; OFFSET ${options.offset}&#96;;\n      }\n    }\n\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\n    const data = result.map((row: any) =&gt; this.parseRow(row)) as Project[];\n    \n    const pageSize = options.limit || total;\n    const page = options.offset ? Math.floor(options.offset / pageSize) + 1 : 1;\n    \n    return {\n      data,\n      total,\n      page,\n      pageSize,\n      totalPages: Math.ceil(total / pageSize)\n    };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 获取精选项目\n   */\n  async findFeatured(limit: number = 10): Promise&lt;Project[]&gt; {\n    const sql = &#96;\n      SELECT * FROM projects \n      WHERE type = ? AND status = ?\n      ORDER BY created_at DESC\n      LIMIT ?\n    &#96;;\n    \n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, [ProjectType.FEATURED, ProjectStatus.ACTIVE, limit]);\n    return result.map((row: any) =&gt; this.parseRow(row)) as Project[];\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 获取最近打开的项目\n   */\n  async findRecent(limit: number = 20): Promise&lt;Project[]&gt; {\n    const sql = &#96;\n      SELECT * FROM projects \n      WHERE status = ? AND last_opened_at IS NOT NULL\n      ORDER BY last_opened_at DESC\n      LIMIT ?\n    &#96;;\n    \n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, [ProjectStatus.ACTIVE, limit]);\n    return result.map((row: any) =&gt; this.parseRow(row)) as Project[];\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 更新项目\n   */\n  async update(id: number, data: UpdateProjectDTO): Promise&lt;Project | null&gt; {\n    const fields: string[] = [];\n    const values: any[] = [];\n\n    Object.entries(data).forEach(([key, value]) =&gt; {\n      if (value !== undefined) {\n        fields.push(&#96;${key} = ?&#96;);\n        values.push(value);\n      }\n    });\n\n    if (fields.length === 0) {\n      return this.findById(id);\n    }\n\n    values.push(id);\n    \n    const sql = &#96;\n      UPDATE projects \n      SET ${fields.join(', ')}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n      WHERE id = ?\n    &#96;;\n\n    await this.db.query(sql, values);\n    return this.findById(id);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 更新最后打开时间\n   */\n  async updateLastOpenedAt(id: number): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n    const sql = &#96;\n      UPDATE projects \n      SET last_opened_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n      WHERE id = ?\n    &#96;;\n    \n    await this.db.query(sql, [id]);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 删除项目（软删除）\n   */\n  async delete(id: number): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n    const sql = &#96;\n      UPDATE projects \n      SET status = ?, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n      WHERE id = ?\n    &#96;;\n    \n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, [ProjectStatus.DELETED, id]);\n    return Array.isArray(result) ? result.length &gt; 0 : (result as any).changes &gt; 0;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 获取项目的来源数量\n   */\n  async getSourceCount(projectId: number): Promise&lt;number&gt; {\n    const sql = 'SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM project_sources WHERE project_id = ?';\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, [projectId]);\n    return result[0].count || 0;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 解析数据库行\n   */\n  private parseRow(row: any): any {\n    if (!row) return row;\n    \n    const parsed = { ...row };\n    \n    // 转换日期字段\n    if (parsed.created_at &amp;&amp; typeof parsed.created_at === 'string') {\n      parsed.created_at = new Date(parsed.created_at);\n    }\n    if (parsed.updated_at &amp;&amp; typeof parsed.updated_at === 'string') {\n      parsed.updated_at = new Date(parsed.updated_at);\n    }\n    if (parsed.last_opened_at &amp;&amp; typeof parsed.last_opened_at === 'string') {\n      parsed.last_opened_at = new Date(parsed.last_opened_at);\n    }\n    \n    return parsed;\n  }\n}\n",

        "contents": "const AddTextModal: React.FC&lt;AddTextModalProps&gt; = \n\n\n  const handleFileChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent&lt;HTMLInputElement&gt;) =&gt; {\n    if (e.target.files) {\n      const newFiles = Array.from(e.target.files);\n      setFiles([...files, ...newFiles]);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleRemoveFile = (index: number) =&gt; {\n    setFiles(files.filter((_, i) =&gt; i !== index));\n  };\n\n  const handleDragOver = useCallback((e: React.DragEvent) =&gt; {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    e.stopPropagation();\n    setIsDragging(true);\n  }, []);\n\n  const handleDragLeave = useCallback((e: React.DragEvent) =&gt; {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    e.stopPropagation();\n    setIsDragging(false);\n  }, []);\n\n  const handleDrop = useCallback((e: React.DragEvent) =&gt; {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    e.stopPropagation();\n    setIsDragging(false);\n    \n    if (mode === \"upload\" &amp;&amp; e.dataTransfer.files) {\n      const newFiles = Array.from(e.dataTransfer.files);\n      setFiles([...files, ...newFiles]);\n    }\n  }, [mode, files]);\n\n  const formatFileSize = (bytes: number): string =&gt; {\n    if (bytes &lt; 1024) return bytes + \" B\";\n    if (bytes &lt; 1024 * 1024) return (bytes / 1024).toFixed(1) + \" KB\";\n    return (bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1) + \" MB\";\n  };\n\n  const supportedFileTypes = \"PDF, PPT, .txt, Markdown, Word (.doc, .docx)\";\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"fixed inset-0 bg-black bg-opacity-50 flex items-center justify-center z-50\n;",

        "contents": "const AddSourceModal: React.FC&lt;AddSourceModalProps&gt; = \n\n\n  const handleFileChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent&lt;HTMLInputElement&gt;) =&gt; {\n    if (e.target.files) {\n      const newFiles = Array.from(e.target.files);\n      setFiles([...files, ...newFiles]);\n      if (!title.trim() &amp;&amp; newFiles.length === 1) {\n        setTitle(newFiles[0].name);\n      }\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleRemoveFile = (index: number) =&gt; {\n    setFiles(files.filter((_, i) =&gt; i !== index));\n  };\n\n  const formatFileSize = (bytes: number): string =&gt; {\n    if (bytes &lt; 1024) return bytes + \" B\";\n    if (bytes &lt; 1024 * 1024) return (bytes / 1024).toFixed(1) + \" KB\";\n    return (bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1) + \" MB\";\n  };\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"fixed inset-0 bg-black bg-opacity-50 flex items-center justify-center z-50\"&gt;\n      &lt;div className=\"bg-white rounded-lg shadow-xl w-full max-w-md mx-4\"&gt;\n        {/* 头部 */}\n        &lt;div className=\"flex items-center justify-between p-6 border-b border-gray-200\"&gt;\n          &lt;h2 className=\"text-xl font-semibold text-gray-900\"&gt;添加来源&lt;/h2&gt;\n          &lt;button\n            onClick={onClose}\n            className=\"p-2 hover:bg-gray-100 rounded-lg transition-colors\"\n          &gt;\n            &lt;X className=\"w-5 h-5 text-gray-500\" /&gt;\n          &lt;/button&gt;\n        &lt;/div&gt;\n\n        {/* 内容 */}\n        &lt;form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className=\"p-6 space-y-4\"&gt;\n          {/* 来源类型选择 */}\n;",

        "contents": "/**\n * 文件上传\n * POST /api/v1/ai-search/upload\n */\nrouter.post(\n  '/upload',\n  upload.array('files', 10),\n  async (req: Request, res: Response) =&gt; {\n    try {\n      // 确保文件表已初始化\n      await initializeFileTable();\n\n      const files = req.files as Express.Multer.File[];\n      \n      if (!files || files.length === 0) {\n        return res.status(400).json(\n          formatApiResponse(false, null, '没有上传文件')\n        );\n      }\n\n      const conversationId = req.body.conversationId || req.query.conversationId;\n      const uploaderId = req.body.uploaderId || req.query.uploaderId;\n      const pageType = req.body.pageType || req.query.pageType as string | undefined; // 'tech-package' | 'press-release'\n\n      // 保存文件到数据库\n      const uploadedFiles = await Promise.all(\n        files.map(async (file) =&gt; {\n          const filePath = file.path;\n        }\n;\n  }",

        },
        "contents": "# Dify 文件上传与传递分析\n\n根据 Dify 对话 API 文档，分析文件传递的正确方式。\n\n## 📋 API 文档关键信息\n\n### 1. 文件上传接口 (POST /files/upload)\n\n**请求格式：**\n- Content-Type: &#96;multipart/form-data&#96;\n- 参数：\n  - &#96;file&#96;: 要上传的文件\n  - &#96;user&#96;: 用户标识（必须和发送消息接口的 user 一致）\n\n**响应格式：**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"id\": \"72fa9618-8f89-4a37-9b33-7e1178a24a67\",\n  \"name\": \"example.png\",\n  \"size\": 1024,\n  \"extension\": \"png\",\n  \"mime_type\": \"image/png\",\n  \"created_by\": 123,\n  \"created_at\": 1577836800\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. 发送消息接口 (POST /chat-messages)\n\n**文件字段格式：**\n\n&#96;files&#96; 字段应该是**对象数组**，每个对象包含：\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n{\n  type: string;              // 文件类型：document | image | audio | video | custom\n  transfer_method: string;   // 传递方式：local_file | remote_url\n  upload_file_id?: string;   // 文件 ID（仅当 transfer_method 为 local_file 时）\n  url?: string;              // 文件 URL（仅当 transfer_method 为 remote_url 时）\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**文件类型支持：**\n- &#96;document&#96;: TXT, MD, MARKDOWN, PDF, HTML, XLSX, XLS, DOCX, CSV, EML, MSG, PPTX, PPT, XML, EPUB\n- &#96;image&#96;: JPG, JPEG, PNG, GIF, WEBP, SVG\n- &#96;audio&#96;: MP3, M4A, WAV, WEBM, AMR\n- &#96;video&#96;: MP4, MOV, MPEG, MPGA\n- &#96;custom&#96;: 其他文件类型\n\n**示例请求：**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"query\": \"What are the specs of the iPhone 13 Pro Max?\",\n  \"inputs\": {},\n  \"response_mode\": \"blocking\",\n  \"conversation_id\": \"\",\n  \"user\": \"abc-123\",\n  \"files\": [\n    {\n      \"type\": \"image\",\n      \"transfer_method\": \"remote_url\",\n      \"url\": \"https://cloud.dify.ai/logo/logo-site.png\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"type\": \"document\",\n      \"transfer_method\": \"local_file\",\n      \"upload_file_id\": \"72fa9618-8f89-4a37-9b33-7e1178a24a67\"\n    }\n  ]\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 🔧 当前实现分析\n\n### ✅ 正确的部分\n\n1. **文件上传流程正确**：\n   - 通过 &#96;/files/upload&#96; 接口上传文件",

          }
        },
        "contents": "/**\n * 与指定AI角色对话\n * POST /api/v1/ai-roles/:id/chat\n * 支持multipart/form-data（带文件）和application/json（不带文件）\n * 注意：必须在 /:id 路由之前定义，否则会被当作 id 处理\n */\nrouter.post('/:id/chat', upload.array('files', 10), async (req, res) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const { id } = req.params;\n    \n    // 处理文件上传\n    const uploadedFiles = req.files as Express.Multer.File[];\n    let fileUrls: string[] = [];\n    \n    if (uploadedFiles &amp;&amp; uploadedFiles.length &gt; 0) {\n      // 保存文件到数据库并获取文件URL\n      const filePromises = uploadedFiles.map(async (file) =&gt; {\n        const filePath = file.path;\n        const fileUrl = &#96;/uploads/ai-roles/${file.filename}&#96;;\n        \n        // 确定文件分类\n        let category = 'general';\n        if (file.mimetype.startsWith('image/')) {\n          category = 'image';\n        } else if (file.mimetype.startsWith('application/pdf') || \n                   file.mimetype.includes('document') || \n                   file.mimetype.includes('word') ||\n                   file.mimetype.includes('text')) {\n          category = 'document';\n        }\n\n        // 处理文件名编码\n        let originalName = file.originalname;\n        try {\n          const hasGarbledChars = /ã€|ç¥|æ|Ã|â€|â€|â€/.test(originalName);\n          if (hasGarbledChars) {\n            const buffer = Buffer.from(originalName, 'latin1');\n            const decoded = buffer.toString('utf8');\n            if (/[\\u4e00-\\u9fa5]/.test(decoded)) {\n              originalName = decoded;\n            }\n          }\n        } catch (e) {\n          // 忽略编码错误，使用原始文件名\n        }\n\n        // 保存文件记录到数据库\n        const fileRecord = await fileService.createFile\n;\n      };\n}",

        "contents": "1. **文件上传流程正确**：\n   - 通过 &#96;/files/upload&#96; 接口上传文件\n   - 获取文件 ID (uuid)\n   - 用户标识一致\n\n2. **文件传递位置正确**：\n   - 在 &#96;files&#96; 字段中传递\n\n### ❌ 需要修正的部分\n\n**问题：当前只传递文件 ID 数组，而不是文件对象数组**\n\n当前代码：\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nfiles: fileIds.length &gt; 0 ? fileIds : undefined  // ❌ 错误：直接传递 ID 数组\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n应该改为：\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nfiles: fileIds.length &gt; 0 ? fileIds.map(fileId =&gt; ({\n  type: detectFileType(fileId),      // 需要根据文件 ID 或文件信息判断类型\n  transfer_method: 'local_file',\n  upload_file_id: fileId\n})) : undefined  // ✅ 正确：传递文件对象数组\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 📝 修正方案\n\n### 1. 需要添加文件类型检测\n\n根据文件的 MIME type 或扩展名判断文件类型：\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nfunction detectFileTypeFromMime(mimeType: string): string {\n  if (mimeType.startsWith('image/')) return 'image';\n  if (mimeType.startsWith('audio/')) return 'audio';\n  if (mimeType.startsWith('video/')) return 'video';\n  if (mimeType.includes('pdf') || \n      mimeType.includes('document') || \n      mimeType.includes('word') ||\n      mimeType.includes('excel') ||\n      mimeType.includes('text') ||\n      mimeType.includes('markdown')) return 'document';\n  return 'custom';\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. 保存文件信息以便后续使用\n\n在上传文件时，需要保存文件的类型信息，以便后续构造正确的 files 数组。\n\n### 3. 修正 executeChat 方法\n\n将文件 ID 数组转换为文件对象数组：\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// 需要在上传文件时保存文件类型信息\nconst fileObjects = fileIds.map((fileId, index) =&gt; {\n  const fileInfo = uploadedFileInfos[index]; // 需要保存上传时的文件信息\n  return {\n    type: detectFileTypeFromMime(fileInfo.mimeType),\n    transfer_method: 'local_file',\n    upload_file_id: fileId\n  };\n});\n\nconst requestBody = {\n  query: input.query,",

        "contents": "  data: {\"event\": \"tts_message\", \"conversation_id\": \"23dd85f3-1a41-4ea0-b7a9-062734ccfaf9\", \"message_id\": \"a8bdc41c-13b2-4c18-bfd9-054b9803038c\", \"created_at\": 1721205487, \"task_id\": \"3bf8a0bb-e73b-4690-9e66-4e429bad8ee7\", \"audio\": \"qqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqq\"}\n  data: {\"event\": \"tts_message_end\", \"conversation_id\": \"23dd85f3-1a41-4ea0-b7a9-062734ccfaf9\", \"message_id\": \"a8bdc41c-13b2-4c18-bfd9-054b9803038c\", \"created_at\": 1721205487, \"task_id\": \"3bf8a0bb-e73b-4690-9e66-4e429bad8ee7\", \"audio\": \"\"}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nCopyCopied!\n\n---\n\nPOST/files/upload\n\n## [上传文件](http://47.113.225.93:9999/app/a541096e-d0c1-48f8-98af-df593cf62428/develop#files-upload)\n\n上传文件并在发送消息时使用，可实现图文多模态理解。 支持您的应用程序所支持的所有格式。 _上传的文件仅供当前终端用户使用。_\n\n### Request Body\n\n该接口需使用 &#96;multipart/form-data&#96; 进行请求。\n\n- Name&#96;file&#96;TypefileDescription\n    \n- 要上传的文件。\n    \n- Name&#96;user&#96;TypestringDescription\n    \n- 用户标识，用于定义终端用户的身份，必须和发送消息接口传入 user 保持一致。\n    \n\n### Response\n\n成功上传后，服务器会返回文件的 ID 和相关信息。\n\n- &#96;id&#96; (uuid) ID\n    \n- &#96;name&#96; (string) 文件名\n    \n- &#96;size&#96; (int) 文件大小（byte）\n    \n- &#96;extension&#96; (string) 文件后缀\n    \n- &#96;mime_type&#96; (string) 文件 mime-type\n    \n- &#96;created_by&#96; (uuid) 上传人 ID\n    \n- &#96;created_at&#96; (timestamp) 上传时间\n    \n\n### Errors\n\n- 400，&#96;no_file_uploaded&#96;，必须提供文件\n    \n- 400，&#96;too_many_files&#96;，目前只接受一个文件\n    \n- 400，&#96;unsupported_preview&#96;，该文件不支持预览\n    \n- 400，&#96;unsupported_estimate&#96;，该文件不支持估算\n    \n- 413，&#96;file_too_large&#96;，文件太大\n    \n- 415，&#96;unsupported_file_type&#96;，不支持的扩展名，当前只接受文档类文件\n    \n- 503，&#96;s3_connection_failed&#96;，无法连接到 S3 服务\n    ",

        "contents": "/**\n * 发送消息\n * POST /api/v1/ai-search/conversations/:id/messages\n */\nrouter.post(\n  '/conversations/:id/messages',\n  ensureTablesInitialized,\n  upload.array('files', 10),\n  async (req: Request, res: Response) =&gt; {\n    try {\n      const { id } = req.params;\n      let sourcesValue = req.body.sources;\n      if (typeof sourcesValue === 'string') {\n        try {\n          sourcesValue = JSON.parse(sourcesValue);\n        } catch (parseError) {\n          logger.warn('解析sources失败，使用原始值', { parseError });\n          sourcesValue = undefined;\n        }\n      }\n\n      const body = {\n        content: req.body.content,\n        sources: Array.isArray(sourcesValue) ? sourcesValue : undefined,\n        contextWindowSize: req.body.contextWindowSize,\n        workflowId: req.body.workflowId,\n        fileList: req.body.fileList,\n        knowledgeBaseNames: req.body.knowledgeBaseNames,\n      };\n      const files = req.files as Express.Multer.File[];\n\n      const dto = validateDTO(SendMessageSchema, body);\n      const result = await sendMessageUseCase.execute({\n        conversationId: id,\n        content: dto.content,\n        sources: dto.sources,\n        files,\n        contextWindowSize: typeof dto.contextWindowSize === 'number' ? dto.contextWindowSize : (dto.contextWindowSize ? parseInt(String(dto.contextWindowSize), 10) : undefined),\n        workflowId: dto.workflowId,\n        fileList: dto.fileList,\n        knowledgeBaseNames: dto.knowledgeBaseNames,\n      });\n\n      if (!result.success) {\n        return res.status(500).json(\n          formatApiResponse(false, null, '发送消息失败', result.error.message)\n        );\n      }\n\n      res.json(\n        formatApiResponse(\n          true,\n          result.value,\n          result.value.error ? '发送消息成功，但工作流执行失败' : '发送消息成功'\n        )\n      );\n    } catch (error) {\n      if (error instanceof ValidationException) {\n        const failure = formatValidationFailure(error);\n  }",

        "contents": "export class FileService {\nprivate generateFileId(): string {\n\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 创建文件记录\n   */\n  async createFile(params: CreateFileParams): Promise&lt;FileRecord&gt; {\n    try {\n      // 计算文件哈希值\n      let fileHash: string | undefined;\n      if (fs.existsSync(params.file_path)) {\n        fileHash = await this.calculateFileHash(params.file_path);\n        \n        // 检查是否已存在相同哈希的文件\n        const existing = await this.findByHash(fileHash);\n        if (existing) {\n          // 如果文件已存在，增加使用次数并返回现有记录\n          await this.incrementUsageCount(existing.file_id);\n          return existing;\n        }\n      }\n\n      const fileId = this.generateFileId();\n      const tagsJson = params.tags ? JSON.stringify(params.tags) : null;\n      const metadataJson = params.metadata ?       "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./guide/workflow/DIFY_FIELD_MAPPING.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 86
          }
        },
        "contents": "# Dify工作流字段对接文档\n\n## 📋 概述\n\n本文档基于 &#96;robot1-技术包装.yml&#96; 工作流配置，详细说明了Todify系统与Dify工作流的字段对接要求。\n\n## 🔍 工作流结构分析\n\n### 工作流节点流程\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n开始 → 上游信息解读(LLM) → 信息整合输出(LLM) → 结束\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 技术配置\n- **模型**: GPT-4\n- **温度**: 0.7\n- **模式**: 聊天模式\n- **文件上传**: 支持但当前未启用\n\n## 📥 输入字段映射\n\n### 字段映射表\n\n| Dify字段 | 系统字段 | 类型 | 必填 | 限制 | 说明 |\n|---------|---------|------|------|------|------|\n| &#96;input1&#96; | &#96;upstream_info&#96; | paragraph | ✅ 是 | 5000字符 | 上游信息 |\n| &#96;input2&#96; | &#96;files&#96; | file-list | ❌ 否 | 5个文件 | 附件上传 |\n| &#96;input3&#96; | &#96;optimization_suggestions&#96; | paragraph | ❌ 否 | 1000字符 | 优化建议 |\n\n### 详细字段说明\n\n#### 1. input1 - 上游信息\n&#96;&#96;&#96;yaml\n# Dify配置\n- default: ''\n  hint: ''\n  label: 上游信息\n  max_length: 5000\n  options: []\n  placeholder: ''\n  required: true\n  type: paragraph\n  variable: input1\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**系统实现要求:**\n- **字段名**: &#96;input1&#96; 或 &#96;upstream_info&#96;\n- **类型**: 字符串 (paragraph)\n- **必填**: 是\n- **最大长度**: 5000字符\n- **UI组件**: 多行文本输入框\n- **验证规则**: 非空 + 长度限制\n\n#### 2. input2 - 附件上传\n&#96;&#96;&#96;yaml\n# Dify配置\n- allowed_file_extensions: []\n  allowed_file_types:\n  - image\n  - document\n  allowed_file_upload_methods:\n  - local_file\n  - remote_url\n  default: ''\n  hint: ''\n  label: 附件上传\n  max_length: 5\n  options: []\n  placeholder: ''\n  required: false\n  type: file-list\n  variable: input2\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**系统实现要求:**\n- **字段名**: &#96;input2&#96; 或 &#96;files&#96;\n- **类型**: 文件数组 (file-list)\n- **必填**: 否\n- **最大文件数**: 5个\n- **支持类型**: 图片、文档\n- **支持扩展名**: .JPG, .JPEG, .PNG, .GIF, .WEBP, .SVG\n- **上传方式**: 本地文件、远程URL\n- **UI组件**: 文件上传组件\n\n#### 3. input3 - 优化建议\n&#96;&#96;&#96;yaml",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [

        "contents": "export class SendMessageUseCase {\nprivate async buildConversationData(\n    params: {\n      conversation: any | null;\n      content: string;\n      sources?: any[];\n      files?: Express.Multer.File[];\n      contextWindowSize?: number;\n      workflowId?: string;\n      fileList?: string;\n      knowledgeBaseNames?: string;\n    }\n  ) {\n\n    if (params.files &amp;&amp; params.files.length &gt; 0) {\n      try {\n        // 通过文件名查找文件记录，获取markdown内容\n        for (const file of params.files) {\n          try {\n            // 通过原始文件名查找文件记录\n            const allFiles = await fileService.getAllFiles({\n              status: 'active',\n            });\n            const fileRecord = allFiles.find(\n              (f) =&gt; f.original_name === file.originalname || f.stored_name === file.filename\n            );\n            \n            if (fileRecord &amp;&amp; fileRecord.metadata) {\n              const metadata = typeof fileRecord.metadata === 'string' \n                ? JSON.parse(fileRecord.metadata) \n                : fileRecord.metadata;\n              \n              if (metadata.markdownContent) {\n                fileMarkdownContents.push(&#96;【${fileRecord.original_name}】\\n${metadata.markdownContent}&#96;);\n                logger.info('从文件记录中提取markdown内容', {\n                  fileName: fileRecord.original_name,\n                  markdownLength: metadata.markdownContent.length,\n                });\n              }\n            }\n          } catch (error) {\n            logger.warn('提取文件markdown内容失败', {\n              fileName: file.originalname,\n              error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),\n            });\n          }\n        }\n      } catch (error) {\n        logger.warn('批量提取文件markdown内容失败', {\n          error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),\n        });\n      }\n    }\n\n    // 判断是否是第一次对话（对话不存在或没有历史消息）\n    const isFirstMessage = !params.conversation || \n                          !params.conversation.messages || \n                          params.conversation.messages.length === 0;\n    \n    // 提取附加信息：外部来源的文本内容和文件的markdown内容\n    let additionalContext = '';\n    \n    const textContents: string[] = [];\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "// 配置multer用于文件上传\nconst storage = multer.diskStorage({\n  destination: (req, file, cb) =&gt; {\n    cb(null, 'uploads/ai-search/');\n  },\n  filename: (req, file, cb) =&gt; {\n    // 生成唯一文件名，但保留原始扩展名\n    const uniqueSuffix = Date.now() + '-' + Math.round(Math.random() * 1E9);\n    const ext = path.extname(file.originalname);\n    cb(null, &#96;${uniqueSuffix}${ext}&#96;);\n  },\n});\n\nconst upload = multer({\n  storage: storage,\n  limits: {\n    fileSize: 10 * 1024 * 1024, // 10MB\n  },\n  fileFilter: (req: Request, file: Express.Multer.File, cb: multer.FileFilterCallback) =&gt; {\n    // 允许的文件类型：PDF, PPT, txt, markdown, word\n    const allowedTypes = [\n      'application/pdf',\n      'application/vnd.ms-powerpoint', // .ppt\n      'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation', // .pptx\n      'application/msword', // .doc\n      'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document', // .docx\n      'text/plain',\n      'text/markdown',\n    ];\n    // 也允许通过扩展名判断\n    const allowedExtensions = ['.pdf', '.ppt', '.pptx', '.doc', '.docx', '.txt', '.md', '.markdown'];\n    const fileExtension = require('path').extname(file.originalname).toLowerCase();\n    \n    if (allowedTypes.includes(file.mimetype) || allowedExtensions.includes(fileExtension)) {\n      cb(null, true);\n    } else {\n      cb(new Error(&#96;不支持的文件类型: ${file.mimetype}。支持的类型：PDF, PPT, txt, markdown, word&#96;));\n    }\n  },\n});\n\n// 确保上传目录存在\nconst uploadDir = 'uploads/ai-search/';\nif (!fs.existsSync(uploadDir)) {\n  fs.mkdirSync(uploadDir, { recursive: true });\n}\n\n// 初始化服务\nconst aiSearchService = new AiSearchService();\nconst fieldMappingService = new FieldMappingService();\nconst createConversationUseCase = new CreateConversationUseCase(aiSearchService);\nconst getConversationsUseCase = new GetConversationsUseCase(aiSearchService);\nconst getConversationDetailUseCase = new GetConversationDetailUseCase(aiSearchService);\nconst sendMessageUseCase = new SendMessageUseCase;",

        "contents": "-- 来源信息表\n-- 用于存储通过 SourceSidebar 添加的信息（包括文本来源和外部来源）\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS source_information (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    source_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE COMMENT '来源唯一标识（前端生成的ID）',\n    title TEXT NOT NULL COMMENT '来源标题',\n    type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (type IN ('knowledge_base', 'external')) COMMENT '来源类型：knowledge_base=知识库，external=外部来源',\n    url TEXT COMMENT '外部来源URL（仅external类型）',\n    description TEXT COMMENT '来源描述/内容',\n    page_type TEXT COMMENT '页面类型：tech-package, press-release, tech-strategy, tech-article',\n    conversation_id TEXT COMMENT '关联的对话ID',\n    metadata TEXT COMMENT '元数据（JSON格式）',\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')) COMMENT '状态',\n    created_by TEXT COMMENT '创建人',\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 创建索引\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_source_id ON source_information(source_id);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_type ON source_information(type);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_page_type ON source_information(page_type);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_conversation_id ON source_information(conversation_id);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_status ON source_information(status);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_created_at ON source_information(created_at);",

        "contents": "export class ProjectModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 创建项目\n   */\n  async create(data: CreateProjectDTO): Promise&lt;Project&gt; {\n    const sql = &#96;\n      INSERT INTO projects (\n        name, description, cover_image, icon, type, status, created_by, last_opened_at\n      )\n      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\n    &#96;;\n    \n    const values = [\n      data.name,\n      data.description || null,\n      data.cover_image || null,\n      data.icon || null,\n      data.type || ProjectType.NORMAL,\n      data.status || ProjectStatus.ACTIVE,\n      data.created_by || null,\n      data.last_opened_at || null\n    ];\n\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\n    const lastId = (result as any).lastID || (result as any).id;\n    \n    // 获取创建的项目\n    return this.findById(lastId) as Promise&lt;Project&gt;;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 根据ID获取项目\n   */\n  async findById(id: number): Promise&lt;Project | null&gt; {\n    const sql = 'SELECT * FROM projects WHERE id = ?';\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class SourceInformationModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 创建来源信息\n   */\n  async create(data: CreateSourceInformationDTO): Promise&lt;SourceInformation&gt; {\n    const sql = &#96;\n      INSERT INTO source_information (\n        source_id, title, type, url, description, page_type, \n        conversation_id, metadata, status, created_by\n      )\n      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\n    &#96;;\n    \n    const values = [\n      data.source_id,\n      data.title,\n      data.type,\n      data.url || null,\n      data.description || null,\n      data.page_type || null,\n      data.conversation_id || null,\n      data.metadata ? JSON.stringify(data.metadata) : null,\n      data.status || 'active',\n      data.created_by || null\n    ];\n\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\n    const id = result.lastID || result.insertId;\n    \n    const sourceInfo = await this.findById(id);\n    if (!sourceInfo) {\n      throw new Error('Failed to create source information');\n    }\n    \n    return sourceInfo;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 根据ID获取来源信息\n   */\n  async findById(id: number): Promise&lt;SourceInformation | null&gt; {\n    const sql = 'SELECT * FROM source_information WHERE id = ?';\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class ProjectModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 获取所有项目\n   */\n  async findAll(options: QueryOptions = {}): Promise&lt;PaginatedResult&lt;Project&gt;&gt; {\n    let sql = 'SELECT * FROM projects';\n    const values: any[] = [];\n    const conditions: string[] = [];\n\n    // 添加WHERE条件\n    if (options.where) {\n      Object.entries(options.where).forEach(([key, value]) =&gt; {\n        if (value === null) {\n          conditions.push(&#96;${key} IS NULL&#96;);\n        } else {\n          conditions.push(&#96;${key} = ?&#96;);\n          values.push(value);\n        }\n      });\n    }\n\n    if (conditions.length &gt; 0) {\n      sql += ' WHERE ' + conditions.join(' AND ');\n    }\n\n    // 添加排序\n    if (options.orderBy) {\n      sql += &#96; ORDER BY ${options.orderBy} ${options.orderDirection || 'ASC'}&#96;;\n    } else {\n      sql += ' ORDER BY created_at DESC';\n    }\n\n    // 获取总数\n    const countSql = sql.replace('SELECT *', 'SELECT COUNT(*) as count');\n    const countResult = await this.db.query(countSql, values);\n    const total = countResult[0].count;\n\n    // 添加分页\n    if (options.limit) {\n      sql += &#96; LIMIT ${options.limit}&#96;;\n      if (options.offset) {\n        sql += &#96; OFFSET ${options.offset}&#96;;\n      }\n    }\n\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\n    const data = result.map((row: any) =&gt; this.parseRow(row)) as Project[];\n    \n    const pageSize = options.limit || total;\n    const page = options.offset ? Math.floor(options.offset / pageSize) + 1 : 1;\n    \n    return {\n      data,\n      total,\n      page,\n      pageSize,\n      totalPages: Math.ceil(total / pageSize)\n    };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 获取精选项目\n   */\n  async findFeatured(limit: number = 10): Promise&lt;Project[]&gt; {\n    const sql = &#96;\n      SELECT * FROM projects \n      WHERE type = ? AND status = ?\n      ORDER BY created_at DESC\n      LIMIT ?\n    &#96;;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "-- 文件存储表\n-- 用于存储上传的文件信息，支持后续反复调用\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS files (\n  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n  file_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, -- 文件唯一标识\n  original_name TEXT NOT NULL, -- 原始文件名\n  stored_name TEXT NOT NULL, -- 存储的文件名\n  file_path TEXT NOT NULL, -- 文件存储路径\n  file_url TEXT NOT NULL, -- 文件访问URL\n  mime_type TEXT NOT NULL, -- 文件MIME类型\n  file_size INTEGER NOT NULL, -- 文件大小（字节）\n  file_hash TEXT, -- 文件哈希值（用于去重）\n  category TEXT DEFAULT 'general', -- 文件分类（general, document, image等）\n  tags TEXT, -- JSON数组格式存储标签\n  description TEXT, -- 文件描述\n  uploader_id TEXT, -- 上传者ID\n  conversation_id TEXT, -- 关联的对话ID（可选）\n  usage_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0, -- 使用次数\n  last_used_at DATETIME, -- 最后使用时间\n  status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\n  metadata TEXT, -- JSON格式存储额外信息\n  created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 创建索引以提高查询性能\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_file_id ON files(file_id);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_category ON files(category);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_status ON files(status);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_conversation_id ON files(conversation_id);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_created_at ON files(created_at);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_file_hash ON files(file_hash);",

  "contents": "import api from './api';\nimport { agentWorkflowService } from './agentWorkflowService';\nimport { techPointService } from './techPointService';\nimport { knowledgePointService } from './knowledgePointService';\nimport {\n  Conversation,\n  Message,\n  OutputContent,\n  WorkflowConfig,\n  FileUploadResponse,\n  CreateConversationRequest,\n  SendMessageRequest,\n  ApiResponse,\n  Source,\n  FieldMappingConfig,\n} from '../types/aiSearch';\n\n/**\n * AI问答服务\n */\nclass AiSearchService {\n  private normalizeMessage(raw: any): Message {\n    return {\n      ...raw,\n      createdAt: raw?.createdAt ? new Date(raw.createdAt) : new Date(),\n    };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 获取配置的工作流\n   */\n  async getWorkflowConfig(pageType?: 'tech-package' | 'press-release' | 'tech-strategy' | 'tech-article'): Promise&lt;WorkflowConfig | null&gt; {\n    try {\n      // 先尝试从API获取配置的工作流ID，传递pageType参数\n      const params = pageType ? &#96;?pageType=${pageType}&#96; : '';\n      const response = await api.get(&#96;/ai-search/workflow${params}&#96;);\n      if (response.data.success &amp;&amp; response.data.data) {\n        const workflowId = response.data.data.workflowId;\n        // 获取工作流详情\n        const workflows = await agentWorkflowService.getAllWorkflows();\n        const workflow = workflows.find((w) =&gt; w.id === workflowId);\n        if (workflow) {\n          return this.convertWorkflowToConfig(workflow);\n        }\n      }\n      \n      // 如果没有配置，尝试查找默认工作流（根据页面类型）\n      const workflows = await agentWorkflowService.getAllWorkflows();\n      const defaultWorkflowName = pageType === 'press-release' ? '发布会稿工作流' : '智能工作流';\n      const defaultWorkflow = workflows.find((w) =&gt; w.name === defaultWorkflowName);\n      if (defaultWorkflow) {\n        return this.convertWorkflowToConfig(defaultWorkflow);\n      }\n      \n      // 返回第一个工作流\n      if (workflows.length &gt; 0) {\n        return this.convertWorkflowToConfig(workflows[0]);\n      }\n      \n      return null;\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('获取工作流配置失败:', error);\n      return null;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 转换工作流为配置格式\n   */\n  private convertWorkflowToConfig(workflow: any): WorkflowConfig {\n    // 从工作流的输入节点和输出节点提取参数\n    const inputNode = workflow.nodes.find((n: any) =&gt; n.type === 'input');\n    const outputNode = workflow.nodes.find((n: any) =&gt; n.type === 'output');\n    \n    const inputParameters = inputNode?.data?.inputs || [];\n    const outputParameters = outputNode?.data?.outputs || [];\n    \n    return {\n      id: workflow.id,\n      name: workflow.name,\n      description: workflow.description,\n      inputParameters: inputParameters.map((p: any) =&gt; ({\n        name: p.name,\n        type: p.type || 'string',\n        required: p.required || false,\n        description: p.description,\n      })),\n      outputParameters: outputParameters.map((p: any) =&gt; ({\n        name: p.name,\n        type: p.type || 'object',\n        description: p.description,\n      })),\n    };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 获取文件列表\n   */\n  async getFiles(options?: {\n    category?: string;",
  "totalLinesInFile": 648
}

        "contents": "import {\n  TechPoint,\n  TechCategory,\n  CarModel,\n  TechPointStats,\n  TechPointSearchParams,\n  TechPointFormData,\n  PaginatedResponse\n} from '../types/techPoint';\nimport { techPointService } from '../services/techPointService';\n\nexport const useTechPoints = () =&gt; {\n  const [techPoints, setTechPoints] = useState&lt;TechPoint[]&gt;([]);\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);\n  const [error, setError] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);\n  const [pagination, setPagination] = useState({\n    total: 0,\n    page: 1,\n    pageSize: 20,\n    totalPages: 0\n  });\n\n  // 获取技术点列表\n  const fetchTechPoints = useCallback(async (params?: TechPointSearchParams) =&gt; {\n    setLoading(true);\n    setError(null);\n    \n    try {\n      const response = await techPointService.getTechPoints(params);\n      if (response.success &amp;&amp; response.data) {\n        setTechPoints(response.data.data);\n        setPagination({\n          total: response.data.total,\n          page: response.data.page,\n          pageSize: response.data.pageSize,\n          totalPages: response.data.totalPages\n        });\n      } else {\n        setError(response.error || '获取技术点列表失败');\n      }\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError('获取技术点列表失败');\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  }, []);\n\n  // 创建技术点\n  const createTechPoint = useCallback(async (data: TechPointFormData) =&gt; {\n    setLoading(true);\n    setError(null);\n    \n    try {\n      const response = await techPointService.createTechPoint(data);\n      if (response.success) {\n        // 重新获取列表\n        await fetchTechPoints();\n        return true;\n      } else {\n        setError(response.error || '创建技术点失败');\n        return false;\n      }\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError('创建技术点失败');\n      return false;\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  }, [fetchTechPoints]);\n\n  // 更新技术点\n  const updateTechPoint = useCallback\n;\n;",

        "contents": "async getTechPoints(\n    params?: TechPointSearchParams\n  ): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;PaginatedResponse&lt;TechPoint&gt;&gt;&gt; {\n\n\n      if (responseData.success &amp;&amp; responseData.data) {\n        // TPD2 返回的 data 格式: { data: [], total: number, page: number, pageSize: number, totalPages: number }\n        // 确保返回格式符合 PaginatedResponse\n        const paginatedData = responseData.data;\n        const dataArray = paginatedData.data || [];\n        const total = paginatedData.total || 0;\n        const page = paginatedData.page || 1;\n        const pageSize = paginatedData.pageSize || 20;\n        const totalPages = paginatedData.totalPages || Math.ceil(total / pageSize);\n        \n        return {\n          success: true,\n          data: {\n            data: dataArray,\n            items: dataArray, // 兼容性：某些地方可能使用 items\n            total,\n            page,\n            pageSize,\n            totalPages,\n          },\n          message: responseData.message,\n        };\n      }\n\n      return {\n        success: false,\n        error: responseData.error || '获取技术点列表失败',\n      };\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      console.error('获取技术点列表失败:', error);\n      return {\n        success: false,\n        error:\n          error.response?.data?.error ||\n          error.message ||\n          '获取技术点列表失败',\n      };\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n// 导出单例实例\nexport const tpdTechPointService = new TPDTechPointService();",

        "contents": "export class TPDSyncService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 同步技术点数据\n   * 从 TPD2 获取所有技术点，并存储到 todify3 数据库（覆盖更新）\n   */\n  async syncTechPoints(): Promise&lt;{\n    success: boolean;\n    message: string;\n    stats: {\n      total: number;\n      created: number;\n      updated: number;\n      errors: number;\n    };\n  }&gt; {\n    const stats = {\n      total: 0,\n      created: 0,\n      updated: 0,\n      errors: 0,\n    };\n\n    try {\n      logger.info('开始同步 TPD2 技术点数据...');\n\n      // 分页获取所有技术点\n      let page = 1;\n      const pageSize = 100;\n      let hasMore = true;\n\n      while (hasMore) {\n        try {\n          // 从 TPD2 获取技术点列表\n          const response = await axios.get(&#96;${this.tpdApiBaseUrl}/tech-points&#96;, {\n            params: {\n              page,\n              pageSize,\n              orderBy: 'created_at',\n              orderDirection: 'ASC',\n            },\n            timeout: 30000,\n          });\n\n          if (response.data.code !== 200 || !response.data.data) {\n            logger.error('TPD2 API 返回错误:', response.data);\n            break;\n          }\n\n          const paginatedData = response.data.data;\n          const techPoints = paginatedData.data || [];\n\n          if (techPoints.length === 0) {\n            hasMore = false;\n            break;\n          }\n\n          stats.total += techPoints.length;\n\n          // 处理每个技术点\n          for (const tpdTechPoint of techPoints) {\n            try {\n              const result = await this.syncSingleTechPoint(tpdTechPoint);\n              if (result.created) {\n                stats.created++;\n              } else {\n                stats.updated++;\n              }\n            } catch (error) {\n              logger.error(&#96;同步技术点失败 (ID: ${tpdTechPoint.id}):&#96;, error);\n              stats.errors++;\n            }\n          }\n\n          // 检查是否还有更多数据\n          if (techPoints.length &lt; pageSize) {\n            hasMore = false;\n          } else {\n            page++;\n          }\n        } catch (error) {\n          logger.error(&#96;获取第 ${page} 页数据失败:&#96;, error);\n      }\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "import api from './api';\nimport {\n  KnowledgePoint,\n  CreateKnowledgePointFormData,\n  UpdateKnowledgePointFormData,\n  KnowledgePointQueryOptions,\n  ApiResponse,\n  PaginatedResponse\n} from '../types/knowledgePoint';\n\nconst KNOWLEDGE_POINT_BASE_URL = '/knowledge-points';\n\nexport const knowledgePointService = {\n  // 创建知识点\n  async create(data: CreateKnowledgePointFormData): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;KnowledgePoint&gt;&gt; {\n    const response = await api.post(KNOWLEDGE_POINT_BASE_URL, data);\n    return response.data;\n  },\n\n  // 根据技术点ID获取知识点列表\n  async getByTechPointId(\n    techPointId: number, \n    options?: KnowledgePointQueryOptions\n  ): Promise&lt;PaginatedResponse&lt;KnowledgePoint&gt;&gt; {\n    const params = {\n      page: options?.page || 1,\n      pageSize: options?.pageSize || 10,\n      orderBy: options?.orderBy || 'created_at',\n      orderDirection: options?.orderDirection || 'DESC'\n    };\n    \n    const response = await api.get(&#96;${KNOWLEDGE_POINT_BASE_URL}/tech-point/${techPointId}&#96;, { params });\n    return response.data;\n  },\n\n  // 根据ID获取知识点详情\n  async getById(id: number): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;KnowledgePoint&gt;&gt; {\n    const response = await api.get(&#96;${KNOWLEDGE_POINT_BASE_URL}/${id}&#96;);\n    return response.data;\n  },\n\n  // 更新知识点\n  async update(id: number, data: UpdateKnowledgePointFormData): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;KnowledgePoint&gt;&gt; {\n    const response = await api.put(&#96;${KNOWLEDGE_POINT_BASE_URL}/${id}&#96;, data);\n    return response.data;\n  },\n\n  // 删除知识点\n  async delete(id: number): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;void&gt;&gt; {\n    const response = await api.delete(&#96;${KNOWLEDGE_POINT_BASE_URL}/${id}&#96;);\n    return response.data;\n  }\n};",

        "contents": "export class CarSeriesModel {\nasync getTechPoints(carSeriesId: number): Promise&lt;any[]&gt; {\n\n      \n      if (testRows.length &gt; 0) {\n        console.log('硬编码查询成功，现在测试参数化查询');\n        \n        const sql = &#96;\n          SELECT \n            tp.id,\n            tp.name,\n            tp.description,\n            tp.tech_type,\n            tp.priority,\n            tp.status,\n            tp.tags,\n            tp.technical_details,\n            tp.benefits,\n            tp.applications,\n            tp.keywords,\n            tp.source_url,\n            tp.created_at,\n            tp.updated_at,\n            tpcm.application_status,\n            tpcm.implementation_date,\n            tpcm.notes as association_notes\n          FROM tech_points tp\n          INNER JOIN tech_point_car_models tpcm ON tp.id = tpcm.tech_point_id\n          INNER JOIN car_models cm ON tpcm.car_model_id = cm.id\n          INNER JOIN car_series cs ON cs.model_id = cm.id\n          WHERE cs.id = ?\n          ORDER BY tp.priority DESC, tp.name ASC\n        &#96;;\n        \n        console.log('执行参数化SQL查询:', sql);\n        console.log('查询参数:', [carSeriesId]);\n        \n        const rows = await this.db.query(sql, [carSeriesId]);\n        \n        console.log('参数化查询结果行数:', rows.length);\n        console.log('参数化查询结果:', rows);\n        \n        return rows.map((row: any) =&gt; ({\n          ...row,\n          tags: row.tags ? JSON.parse(row.tags) : [],\n          technical_details: row.technical_details ? JSON.parse(row.technical_details) : null,\n          benefits: row.benefits ? JSON.parse(row.benefits) : [],\n          applications: row.applications ? JSON.parse(row.applications) : [],\n          keywords: row.keywords ? JSON.parse(row.keywords) : []\n        }));\n      } else {\n        console.log('硬编码查询也失败了，返回空数组');\n        return [];\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('获取车系技术点失败:', error);\n      throw new Error('获取车系技术点失败');\n    }\n  }\n}\n\nexport const carSeriesModel = new CarSeriesModel();",

        "contents": "// 根据技术点ID获取知识点列表\nrouter.get('/tech-point/:techPointId', async (req: Request, res: Response) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const techPointId = parseInt(req.params.techPointId);\n    const page = parseInt(req.query.page as string) || 1;\n    const pageSize = parseInt(req.query.pageSize as string) || 10;\n    const orderBy = req.query.orderBy as string || 'created_at';\n    const orderDirection = (req.query.orderDirection as string || 'DESC').toUpperCase();\n\n    if (isNaN(techPointId)) {\n      return res.status(400).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: '无效的技术点ID'\n      });\n    }\n\n    const options = {\n      limit: pageSize,\n      offset: (page - 1) * pageSize,\n      orderBy,\n      orderDirection: orderDirection as 'ASC' | 'DESC'\n    };\n\n    const result = await knowledgePointService.getKnowledgePointsByTechPointId(techPointId, options);\n    \n    res.json({\n      success: true,\n      data: result.data,\n      pagination: {\n        page: result.page,\n        pageSize: result.pageSize,\n        total: result.total,\n        totalPages: result.totalPages\n      }\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('获取知识点列表失败:', error);\n    res.status(500).json({\n      success: false,\n      message: '获取知识点列表失败',\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n    });\n  }\n});\n\n// 根据ID获取知识点详情\nrouter.get",

        "contents": "export class TechPointModel {\nasync findById(id: number): Promise&lt;TechPoint | null&gt; {\n\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 获取所有技术点\n   */\n  async findAll(options: QueryOptions = {}): Promise&lt;PaginatedResult&lt;TechPoint&gt;&gt; {\n    let sql = 'SELECT * FROM tech_points';\n    const values: any[] = [];\n    const conditions: string[] = [];\n\n    // 添加WHERE条件\n    if (options.where) {\n      Object.entries(options.where).forEach(([key, value]) =&gt; {\n        conditions.push(&#96;${key} = ?&#96;);\n        values.push(value);\n      });\n    }\n\n    if (conditions.length &gt; 0) {\n      sql += ' WHERE ' + conditions.join(' AND ');\n    }\n\n    // 添加排序\n    if (options.orderBy) {\n      sql += &#96; ORDER BY ${options.orderBy} ${options.orderDirection || 'ASC'}&#96;;\n    } else {\n      sql += ' ORDER BY created_at DESC';\n    }\n\n    // 获取总数\n    const countSql = sql.replace('SELECT *', 'SELECT COUNT(*) as count');\n    const countResult = await this.db.query(countSql, values);\n    const total = countResult[0].count;\n\n    // 添加分页\n    if (options.limit) {\n      sql += &#96; LIMIT ${options.limit}&#96;;\n      if (options.offset) {\n        sql += &#96; OFFSET ${options.offset}&#96;;\n      }\n    }\n\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\n    const data = result.map((row: any) =&gt; this.parseJsonFields(row)) as TechPoint[];\n    \n    const pageSize = options.limit || total;\n    const page = options.offset ? Math.floor(options.offset / pageSize) + 1 : 1;\n    \n    return {\n      data,\n      total,\n      page,\n      pageSize,\n      totalPages: Math.ceil(total / pageSize)\n    };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 根据分类ID获取技术点\n   */\n  async findByCategoryId(categoryId: number, options: QueryOptions = {}): Promise&lt;TechPoint[]&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "import { TPD_API_BASE_URL } from '../config/tpd';\nimport {\n  TechPoint,\n  ApiResponse,\n  PaginatedResponse,\n  TechPointSearchParams,\n} from '../types/techPoint';\n\n/**\n * TPD2 项目技术点服务\n * 用于访问 TPD2 项目的技术点对外服务 API\n */\nclass TPDTechPointService {\n  private client: AxiosInstance;\n\n  constructor() {\n    this.client = axios.create({\n      baseURL: TPD_API_BASE_URL,\n      timeout: 30000,\n      headers: {\n        'Content-Type': 'application/json',\n      },\n    });\n\n    // 响应拦截器：将 TPD2 的响应格式转换为 todify3 期望的格式\n    this.client.interceptors.response.use(\n      (response) =&gt; {\n        // TPD2 响应格式: { code: 200, message: 'success', data: {...}, requestId: '...' }\n        // todify3 期望格式: { success: true, data: {...} }\n        if (response.data &amp;&amp; response.data.code === 200) {\n          return {\n            ...response,\n            data: {\n              success: true,\n              data: response.data.data,\n              message: response.data.message,\n            },\n          };\n        }\n        return response;\n      },\n      (error) =&gt; {\n        // 错误响应格式转换\n        if (error.response &amp;&amp; error.response.data) {\n          const tpdError = error.response.data;\n          return Promise.reject({\n            ...error,\n            response: {\n              ...error.response,\n              data: {\n                success: false,\n                error: tpdError.message || '请求失败',\n                code: tpdError.code,\n              },\n            },\n          });\n        }\n        return Promise.reject(error);\n      }\n    );\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 获取技术点列表\n   * 将 TPD2 的查询参数映射到 TPD2 API 期望的格式\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "export class CarSeriesModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 获取车系关联的技术点\n   */\n  async getTechPoints(carSeriesId: number): Promise&lt;any[]&gt; {\n    try {\n      await this.ensureConnection();\n      \n      console.log('获取车系技术点 - carSeriesId:', carSeriesId);\n      console.log('carSeriesId type:', typeof carSeriesId);\n      \n      // 先测试硬编码的查询\n      const testSql = &#96;\n        SELECT \n          tp.id,\n          tp.name,\n          tp.description,\n          tp.tech_type,\n          tp.priority,\n          tp.status,\n          tp.tags,\n          tp.technical_details,\n          tp.benefits,\n          tp.applications,\n          tp.keywords,\n          tp.source_url,\n          tp.created_at,\n          tp.updated_at,\n          tpcm.application_status,\n          tpcm.implementation_date,\n          tpcm.notes as association_notes\n        FROM tech_points tp\n        INNER JOIN tech_point_car_models tpcm ON tp.id = tpcm.tech_point_id\n        INNER JOIN car_models cm ON tpcm.car_model_id = cm.id\n        INNER JOIN car_series cs ON cs.model_id = cm.id\n        WHERE cs.id = 1\n        ORDER BY tp.priority DESC, tp.name ASC\n      &#96;;\n      \n      console.log('执行测试SQL查询（硬编码）:', testSql);\n      \n      const testRows = await this.db.query(testSql, []);\n      \n      console.log('测试查询结果行数:', testRows.length);\n      console.log('测试查询结果:', testRows);\n      \n      if (testRows.length &gt; 0) {\n        console.log\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class TechPointModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 获取技术点树结构\n   */\n  async getTree(categoryId?: number): Promise&lt;TechPoint[]&gt; {\n    let sql = &#96;\n      SELECT * FROM tech_points \n      WHERE status = ?\n    &#96;;\n    const values: any[] = [Status.ACTIVE];\n\n    if (categoryId) {\n      sql += ' AND category_id = ?';\n      values.push(categoryId);\n    }\n\n    sql += ' ORDER BY level ASC, priority DESC, created_at DESC';\n    \n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\n    const techPoints = result.map((row: any) =&gt; this.parseJsonFields(row)) as TechPoint[];\n    \n    // 构建树结构\n    const techPointMap = new Map&lt;number, TechPoint &amp; { children?: TechPoint[] }&gt;();\n    const rootTechPoints: (TechPoint &amp; { children?: TechPoint[] })[] = [];\n\n    // 初始化所有技术点\n    techPoints.forEach(techPoint =&gt; {\n      techPointMap.set(techPoint.id, { ...techPoint, children: [] });\n    });\n\n    // 构建父子关系\n    techPoints.forEach(techPoint =&gt; {\n      const techPointWithChildren = techPointMap.get(techPoint.id)!;\n      \n      if (techPoint.parent_id === null) {\n        rootTechPoints.push(techPointWithChildren);\n      } else {\n        const parent = techPointMap.get(techPoint.parent_id!);\n        if (parent) {\n          parent.children!.push(techPointWithChildren);\n        }\n      }\n    });\n\n    return rootTechPoints;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 更新技术点\n   */\n  async update(id: number, data: UpdateTechPointDTO): Promise&lt;TechPoint | null&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "// 根据技术点ID获取知识点列表\nrouter.get('/tech-point/:techPointId', async (req: Request, res: Response) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const techPointId = parseInt(req.params.techPointId);\n    const page = parseInt(req.query.page as string) || 1;\n    const pageSize = parseInt(req.query.pageSize as string) || 10;\n    const orderBy = req.query.orderBy as string || 'created_at';\n    const orderDirection = (req.query.orderDirection as string || 'DESC').toUpperCase();\n\n    if (isNaN(techPointId)) {\n      return res.status(400).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: '无效的技术点ID'\n      });\n    }\n\n    const options = {\n      limit: pageSize,\n      offset: (page - 1) * pageSize,\n      orderBy,\n      orderDirection: orderDirection as 'ASC' | 'DESC'\n    };\n\n    const result = await knowledgePointService.getKnowledgePointsByTechPointId(techPointId, options);\n    \n    res.json({\n      success: true,\n      data: result.data,\n      pagination: {\n        page: result.page,\n        pageSize: result.pageSize,\n        total: result.total,\n        totalPages: result.totalPages\n      }\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('获取知识点列表失败:', error);\n    res.status(500).json({\n      success: false,\n      message: '获取知识点列表失败',\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n    });\n  }\n});\n\n// 根据ID获取知识点详情\nrouter.get",

        "contents": "export class KnowledgePointService {\nasync getKnowledgePointById(id: number): Promise&lt;KnowledgePoint | null&gt; {\n\n  }\n\n  // 根据技术点ID获取知识点列表\n  async getKnowledgePointsByTechPointId(\n    techPointId: number, \n    options: QueryOptions = {}\n  ): Promise&lt;PaginatedResult&lt;KnowledgePoint&gt;&gt; {\n    const { limit = 10, offset = 0, orderBy = 'created_at', orderDirection = 'DESC' } = options;\n    \n    // 获取总数\n    const countSql = &#96;\n      SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM knowledge_points \n      WHERE tech_point_id = ? AND status != 'archived'\n    &#96;;\n    const countResult = await this.db.query(countSql, [techPointId]);\n    const total = Array.isArray(countResult) ? countResult[0].total : countResult.total;\n    \n    // 获取数据\n    const sql = &#96;\n      SELECT * FROM knowledge_points \n      WHERE tech_point_id = ? AND status != 'archived'\n      ORDER BY ${orderBy} ${orderDirection}\n      LIMIT ? OFFSET ?\n    &#96;;\n    \n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, [techPointId, limit, offset]);\n    const rows = Array.isArray(result) ? result : [result];\n    \n    const data = rows.map(row =&gt; this.formatKnowledgePoint(row));\n    \n    return {\n      data,\n      total,\n      page: Math.floor(offset / limit) + 1,\n      pageSize: limit,\n      totalPages: Math.ceil(total / limit)\n    };\n  }\n\n  // 更新知识点\n  async updateKnowledgePoint(id: number, data: UpdateKnowledgePointDTO): Promise&lt;KnowledgePoint | null&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "class TPDTechPointService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 获取技术点列表\n   * 将 TPD2 的查询参数映射到 TPD2 API 期望的格式\n   */\n  async getTechPoints(\n    params?: TechPointSearchParams\n  ): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;PaginatedResponse&lt;TechPoint&gt;&gt;&gt; {\n    try {\n      // 构建 TPD2 API 查询参数\n      const queryParams: Record&lt;string, any&gt; = {};\n\n      if (params?.page) {\n        queryParams.page = params.page.toString();\n      }\n      if (params?.pageSize) {\n        queryParams.pageSize = params.pageSize.toString();\n      }\n      if (params?.keyword) {\n        queryParams.keyword = params.keyword;\n      }\n      if (params?.category_id) {\n        queryParams.category_id = params.category_id.toString();\n      }\n      if (params?.status) {\n        queryParams.status = params.status;\n      }\n      if (params?.type) {\n        queryParams.tech_type = params.type;\n      }\n      if (params?.priority) {\n        queryParams.priority = params.priority;\n      }\n      if (params?.sortBy) {\n        queryParams.orderBy = params.sortBy;\n      }\n      if (params?.sortOrder) {\n        queryParams.orderDirection = params.sortOrder.toUpperCase();\n      }\n\n      const response = await this.client.get('/tech-points', {\n        params: queryParams,\n      });\n\n      // 响应已经被拦截器转换，现在格式是 { success: true, data: {...} }\n      const responseData = response.data;\n\n      if (responseData.success &amp;&amp; responseData.data)\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class TechPointController {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 获取技术点列表\n   */\n  async getAll(req: Request, res: Response) {\n    try {\n      console.log('TechPointController.getAll called with query:', req.query);\n      \n      const {\n        page = 1,\n        pageSize = 20,\n        orderBy = 'created_at',\n        orderDirection = 'DESC',\n        status,\n        category_id,\n        parent_id,\n        tech_type,\n        priority\n      } = req.query;\n\n      const options = {\n        limit: parseInt(pageSize as string),\n        offset: (parseInt(page as string) - 1) * parseInt(pageSize as string),\n        orderBy: orderBy as string,\n        orderDirection: orderDirection as 'ASC' | 'DESC',\n        where: {} as any\n      };\n\n      if (status) {\n        options.where.status = status;\n      }\n      if (category_id) {\n        options.where.category_id = parseInt(category_id as string);\n      }\n      if (parent_id !== undefined) {\n        options.where.parent_id = parent_id === 'null' ? null : parseInt(parent_id as string);\n      }\n      if (tech_type) {\n        options.where.tech_type = tech_type;\n      }\n      if (priority) {\n        options.where.priority = priority;\n      }\n\n      console.log('Query options:', options);\n      \n      const result = await techPointModel.findAll(options);\n      console.log('Query result:', result);\n      \n      res.json({\n        success: true,\n        data: result\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Get tech points error:', error);\n      console.error('Error stack:', error instanceof Error ? error.stack : 'Unknown error');\n      res.status(500).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: '获取技术点列表失败',\n        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 根据分类获取技术点\n   */\n  async getByCategoryId(req: Request, res: Response) {\n    try\n  }\n}",

  "contents": "import { Router, Request, Response } from 'express';\nimport { KnowledgePointService } from '../services/knowledgePointService';\nimport { CreateKnowledgePointDTO, UpdateKnowledgePointDTO } from '../types/database';\n\nconst router = Router();\nconst knowledgePointService = new KnowledgePointService();\n\n// 创建知识点\nrouter.post('/', async (req: Request, res: Response) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const data: CreateKnowledgePointDTO = req.body;\n    \n    // 验证必填字段\n    if (!data.tech_point_id || !data.title || !data.content) {\n      return res.status(400).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: '技术点ID、标题和内容为必填字段'\n      });\n    }\n\n    const knowledgePoint = await knowledgePointService.createKnowledgePoint(data);\n    \n    res.status(201).json({\n      success: true,\n      data: knowledgePoint,\n      message: '知识点创建成功'\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('创建知识点失败:', error);\n    res.status(500).json({\n      success: false,\n      message: '创建知识点失败',\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n    });\n  }\n});\n\n// 根据技术点ID获取知识点列表\nrouter.get('/tech-point/:techPointId', async (req: Request, res: Response) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const techPointId = parseInt(req.params.techPointId);\n    const page = parseInt(req.query.page as string) || 1;\n    const pageSize = parseInt(req.query.pageSize as string) || 10;\n    const orderBy = req.query.orderBy as string || 'created_at';\n    const orderDirection = (req.query.orderDirection as string || 'DESC').toUpperCase();\n\n    if (isNaN(techPointId)) {\n      return res.status(400).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: '无效的技术点ID'\n      });\n    }\n\n    const options = {\n      limit: pageSize,\n      offset: (page - 1) * pageSize,\n      orderBy,\n      orderDirection: orderDirection as 'ASC' | 'DESC'\n    };\n\n    const result = await knowledgePointService.getKnowledgePointsByTechPointId(techPointId, options);\n    \n    res.json({\n      success: true,\n      data: result.data,\n      pagination: {\n        page: result.page,\n        pageSize: result.pageSize,\n        total: result.total,\n        totalPages: result.totalPages\n      }\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('获取知识点列表失败:', error);\n    res.status(500).json({\n      success: false,\n      message: '获取知识点列表失败',\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n    });\n  }\n});\n\n// 根据ID获取知识点详情\nrouter.get('/:id', async (req: Request, res: Response) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const id = parseInt(req.params.id);\n    \n    if (isNaN(id)) {\n      return res.status(400).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: '无效的知识点ID'\n      });\n    }\n\n    const knowledgePoint = await knowledgePointService.getKnowledgePointById(id);\n    \n    if (!knowledgePoint) {\n      return res.status(404).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: '知识点不存在'\n      });\n    }\n    \n    res.json({\n      success: true,\n      data: knowledgePoint\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('获取知识点详情失败:', error);\n    res.status(500).json({\n      success: false,\n      message: '获取知识点详情失败',\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n    });\n  }\n});\n\n// 更新知识点\nrouter.put('/:id', async (req: Request, res: Response) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const id = parseInt(req.params.id);\n    const data: UpdateKnowledgePointDTO = req.body;\n    \n    if (isNaN(id)) {\n      return res.status(400).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: '无效的知识点ID'\n      });\n    }\n\n    const knowledgePoint = await knowledgePointService.updateKnowledgePoint(id, data);\n    \n    if (!knowledgePoint) {\n      return res.status(404).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: '知识点不存在'\n      });\n    }\n    \n    res.json({\n      success: true,\n      data: knowledgePoint,\n      message: '知识点更新成功'\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('更新知识点失败:', error);\n    res.status(500).json({\n      success: false,\n      message: '更新知识点失败',\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n    });\n  }\n});\n\n// 删除知识点\nrouter.delete('/:id', async (req: Request, res: Response) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const id = parseInt(req.params.id);\n    \n    if (isNaN(id)) {\n      return res.status(400).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: '无效的知识点ID'\n      });\n    }\n\n    const success = await knowledgePointService.deleteKnowledgePoint(id);\n    \n    if (!success) {\n      return res.status(404).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: '知识点不存在或删除失败'\n      });\n    }\n    \n    res.json({\n      success: true,\n      message: '知识点删除成功'\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('删除知识点失败:', error);\n    res.status(500).json({\n      success: false,\n      message: '删除知识点失败',\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n    });\n  }\n});\n\nexport default router;",

                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"-- 项目表\\n-- 用于存储项目（笔记本）信息\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS projects (\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\n    name TEXT NOT NULL COMMENT '项目名称',\\n    description TEXT COMMENT '项目描述',\\n    cover_image TEXT COMMENT '封面图片URL/路径',\\n    icon TEXT COMMENT '图标（emoji或图标标识符）',\\n    type TEXT DEFAULT 'normal' CHECK (type IN ('normal', 'featured')) COMMENT '项目类型：normal=普通，featured=精选',\\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')) COMMENT '状态',\\n    created_by TEXT COMMENT '创建人',\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    last_opened_at DATETIME COMMENT '最后打开时间'\\n);\\n\\n-- 项目来源表\\n-- 用于关联项目与各种来源（文件、URL、文本、技术点等）\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_sources (\\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\n    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL COMMENT '项目ID',\\n    source_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source_type IN ('file', 'url', 'text', 'tech_point', 'knowledge_point')) COMMENT '来源类型',\\n    source_content TEXT NOT NULL COMMENT '来源内容（URL、文件路径、文本内容等）',\\n    source_title TEXT COMMENT '来源标题',\\n    source_description TEXT COMMENT '来源描述',\\n    metadata TEXT COMMENT '元数据（JSON格式）',\\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\\n    FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\\n);\\n\\n-- 创建索引\\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_projects_type ON projects(type);\\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_projects_status ON projects(status);\\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_projects_created_at ON projects(created_at);\\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_projects_last_opened_at ON projects(last_opened_at);\\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_project_sources_project_id ON project_sources(project_id);\\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_project_sources_source_type ON project_sources(source_type);\\n\","

  "contents": "import api from './api';\nimport {\n  KnowledgePoint,\n  CreateKnowledgePointFormData,\n  UpdateKnowledgePointFormData,\n  KnowledgePointQueryOptions,\n  ApiResponse,\n  PaginatedResponse\n} from '../types/knowledgePoint';\n\nconst KNOWLEDGE_POINT_BASE_URL = '/knowledge-points';\n\nexport const knowledgePointService = {\n  // 创建知识点\n  async create(data: CreateKnowledgePointFormData): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;KnowledgePoint&gt;&gt; {\n    const response = await api.post(KNOWLEDGE_POINT_BASE_URL, data);\n    return response.data;\n  },\n\n  // 根据技术点ID获取知识点列表\n  async getByTechPointId(\n    techPointId: number, \n    options?: KnowledgePointQueryOptions\n  ): Promise&lt;PaginatedResponse&lt;KnowledgePoint&gt;&gt; {\n    const params = {\n      page: options?.page || 1,\n      pageSize: options?.pageSize || 10,\n      orderBy: options?.orderBy || 'created_at',\n      orderDirection: options?.orderDirection || 'DESC'\n    };\n    \n    const response = await api.get(&#96;${KNOWLEDGE_POINT_BASE_URL}/tech-point/${techPointId}&#96;, { params });\n    return response.data;\n  },\n\n  // 根据ID获取知识点详情\n  async getById(id: number): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;KnowledgePoint&gt;&gt; {\n    const response = await api.get(&#96;${KNOWLEDGE_POINT_BASE_URL}/${id}&#96;);\n    return response.data;\n  },\n\n  // 更新知识点\n  async update(id: number, data: UpdateKnowledgePointFormData): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;KnowledgePoint&gt;&gt; {\n    const response = await api.put(&#96;${KNOWLEDGE_POINT_BASE_URL}/${id}&#96;, data);\n    return response.data;\n  },\n\n  // 删除知识点\n  async delete(id: number): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;void&gt;&gt; {\n    const response = await api.delete(&#96;${KNOWLEDGE_POINT_BASE_URL}/${id}&#96;);\n    return response.data;\n  }\n};",

}

所有待办事项已完成。总结如下：

## 完成的工作

1. **路由设置**：在 `App.tsx` 中添加了 `/project/:projectId/resources` 路由
2. **导航更新**：更新了 `HomePage.tsx` 中的 `handleProjectClick`，点击项目卡片会导航到资源管理页面
3. **页面创建**：创建了 `ProjectResourcesPage.tsx`，包含四个主要模块：
   - **上传文件**：支持拖拽上传，使用现有的 `aiSearchService.uploadFiles` API
   - **检索信息**：显示已上传的资源列表，支持搜索过滤
   - **关联技术点信息选择**：下拉选择器，支持多选技术点
   - **公用知识库资源选择**：根据选中的技术点动态加载知识点，支持搜索和多选

## 功能特点

- 响应式布局：左右两栏，适配不同屏幕
- 文件上传：支持拖拽和点击上传
- 实时搜索：来源信息和技术点支持实时搜索过滤
- 动态加载：选择技术点后自动加载相关知识点
- 交互优化：点击外部关闭下拉菜单，选中项显示标签

所有代码已通过 linter 检查，无错误。点击项目卡片即可进入资源管理页面。

已调整页面布局。主要变更：

## 布局调整

1. **左侧：来源选择区域**
   - 上传文件
   - 检索信息（搜索和查看所有来源）
   - 关联技术点信息选择
   - 公用知识库资源选择

2. **右侧：已配置成功的资源清单**
   - 已上传文件：显示所有已上传的文件，带绿色勾选标记
   - 已选择技术点：显示所有已选择的技术点
   - 已选择知识点：显示所有已选择的知识点

## 功能特点

- 实时更新：右侧清单会根据左侧选择自动更新
- 清晰标识：已配置的资源显示绿色勾选标记
- 分类显示：按文件、技术点、知识点分类展示
- 数量统计：每个分类显示数量

页面已按新布局组织，左侧用于选择来源，右侧显示已配置的资源清单。

已在“已配置成功的资源清单”中添加“互联网信息点”栏。主要变更：

## 添加的功能

1. **互联网信息点栏**：在“已上传文件”和“已选择技术点”之间新增
2. **数据来源**：显示来自左侧“检索信息”模块的所有来源（sources）
3. **显示内容**：
   - 标题
   - URL（如有，可点击跳转）
   - 描述
   - 创建时间
   - 绿色勾选标记表示已配置

## 逻辑说明

- **已上传文件**：仅显示通过文件上传功能上传的文件（URL 不是 http 链接）
- **互联网信息点**：显示所有来自“检索信息”模块的来源（所有 sources）
- **已选择技术点**：显示已选择的技术点
- **已选择知识点**：显示已选择的知识点

右侧资源清单现在包含四个部分，其中“互联网信息点”显示来自“检索信息”模块的所有来源。

## 新增功能框

1. **位置**：位于右侧栏底部，在"已选择知识点"之后
2. **包含三个功能入口按钮**：
   - **技术问答**：跳转到 `/ai-qa` 页面
   - **技术策略**：跳转到 `/tech-strategy` 页面
   - **技术包装**：跳转到 `/tech-package` 页面

3. **样式特点**：
   - 浅蓝色背景（`bg-blue-50`）
   - 悬停效果（`hover:bg-blue-100`）
   - 蓝色文字（`text-blue-700`）
   - 圆角按钮
   - 垂直堆叠布局
   - 按钮宽度占满容器

4. **功能**：
   - 点击按钮会跳转到对应页面
   - 跳转时携带项目ID参数（如果存在），便于在目标页面中使用项目上下文

功能框已添加，用户可通过这三个按钮快速访问相关功能页面。
